entries.title: 2023 metrics-pipeline migration cutover order
entries.body:
# 2023 migration service inventory

Unordered services covered by the migration: ingest-edge, metrics-router, and shard-keeper.

The original sequencing decision and rationale are not recorded here.

args.body:
# Historical 2023 cutover decision

The original 2023 service sequence was:

1. ingest-edge
2. metrics-router
3. shard-keeper

ingest-edge was first because it had the lowest blast radius. shard-keeper was last because its long-tail cardinality logic had become complicated. This ordering was the fixed 2023 cutover plan.
